about.description:
Provides structures common to the gRPC and OpenAPI clients. In particular, it provides
a ClientConfiguration type which is used to configure the clients using local QCS settings.

script.content:
PY="${PYTHON}"
if [[ "${target_platform}" != "${build_platform:-${target_platform}}" ]]; then
  PY="${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/python"
fi

"${PY}" -m pip install qcs_api_client_common \
  --no-build-isolation \
  --no-deps \
  --no-index \
  --only-binary :all: \
  --find-links=wheels/ \
  --prefix "${PREFIX}"

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: qcs-api-client-common
  version: "0.21.0"

recipe:
  name: qcs-api-client-common-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/rigetti/qcs-api-client-rust/archive/refs/tags/common/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 18872a67a5a6a21db8ec921b8bcf2c37543b177db94299d383fd02536bddf961

build:
  number: 3

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: qcs-api-client-common-split-build
    build:
      script:
        interpreter: bash
        content: |
          maturin build --release --manifest-path "${SRC_DIR}"/qcs-api-client-common/Cargo.toml --out "${SRC_DIR}"/wheels
          cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - if: not unix
          then: m2-bash
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0.0
            - python
      host:
        - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0.0
        - python

  - package:
      name: qcs_api_client_common
    inherit: qcs-api-client-common-split-build
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('qcs-api-client-common', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('qcs-api-client-common', exact=True) }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - python
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - qcs_api_client_common
          pip_check: true

  - package:
      name: qcs-api-client-common
    inherit: qcs-api-client-common-split-build
    build:
      script:
        interpreter: bash
        content: |
          PY="${PYTHON}"
          if [[ "${target_platform}" != "${build_platform:-${target_platform}}" ]]; then
            PY="${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/python"
          fi

          "${PY}" -m pip install qcs_api_client_common \
            --no-build-isolation \
            --no-deps \
            --no-index \
            --only-binary :all: \
            --find-links=wheels/ \
            --prefix "${PREFIX}"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - if: not unix
          then: m2-bash
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - python
      host:
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools
      run:
        - grpcio >=1.63.0
        - grpc-interceptor >=0.15.0
        - httpx >=0.27.0
        - python
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - python
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - qcs_api_client_common
          pip_check: true
      - files:
          source:
            - qcs-api-client-common/tests
            - qcs-api-client-common/tests_py
        requirements:
          run:
            - pip
            - protobuf
            - pytest >=8.1.1
            - pytest-asyncio >=0.23.6
            - pytest-mock >=3.14.0
            - python
            - syrupy >=4.0.0
            - if: not unix
              then: m2-bash
        script:
          interpreter: bash
          env:
            # `test_sync_method_from_async_context` and `test_refresh_interceptor` call
            # `ClientConfiguration.load_default()` without one of the `monkeypatch` fixtures,
            # so they fall back to `~/.qcs/settings.toml`, which does not exist on the build
            # workers. Point them at the fixtures shipped in the tarball instead; the tests
            # that need a different configuration set these variables themselves.
            QCS_SETTINGS_FILE_PATH: "tests_py/fixtures/settings.toml"
            QCS_SECRETS_FILE_PATH: "tests_py/fixtures/secrets.toml"
          content:
            - cd qcs-api-client-common
            - if: unix
              then:
                - pytest -v
            - if: win
              then:
                # `test_default` and `test_load_profile` compare against syrupy snapshots that
                # embed the fixture paths with forward slashes, while `fixture_env` builds them
                # with `pathlib`, so on Windows they compare `tests_py\fixtures\settings.toml`
                # against `tests_py/fixtures/settings.toml` and can never match. Upstream test
                # bug rather than a packaging problem; the other 17 tests do run on Windows.
                - pytest -v --deselect tests_py/test_configuration.py::TestClientConfiguration::test_default --deselect tests_py/test_configuration.py::TestClientConfiguration::test_load_profile

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/rigetti/qcs-api-client-rust
  summary: Rust clients for Rigetti APIs
  description: |
    Provides structures common to the gRPC and OpenAPI clients. In particular, it provides
    a ClientConfiguration type which is used to configure the clients using local QCS settings.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - BastianZim
    - MementoRC
